decisions.reason: As a close fit with the firm's water-infrastructure equipment business and newly launched in 2024, it is likely to be retained at least another year, though its more limited website presence suggests somewhat higher review risk than the stronger-highlighted products.

This product strongly matches the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, efficient and energy-conscious operation of water facilities, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it so soon after launch.

A product line with several models and its own website page indicates commitment and expected market relevance in the firm's core water-level regulation business, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
